persona.name: Baptiste Charrier

occupation.title: Master's Student in Civil Engineering (apprenticeship track)
occupation.organization: Polytech Montpellier, with an apprenticeship at a regional construction firm
occupation.description: Alternates weeks between coursework and a site-engineering apprenticeship on a tramway extension project. Lives alone for the first time in a studio near Place de la Comedie. His salary is real but small, and his cooking skills are two steps behind his ambitions.

persona.education: Prepa integree then engineering school at Polytech Montpellier; the apprenticeship contract was the family's proudest news last year.
long_term_goals: Graduate and land a site engineer role on big infrastructure
Learn to actually cook — his own kitchen shame list is long
Save enough to stop calculating every restaurant bill
persona.style: Earnest, curious, and a little self-deprecating about his student-life chaos. Asks genuine questions and admits what he doesn't know, which makes older colleagues adopt him. Runs in worn-out trainers, dresses site-casual, texts in fragments but talks in paragraphs. New services excite him if the price fits a spreadsheet he actually maintains.

traits: Eager to learn practical life skills

interests: Learning-to-cook YouTube (watches more than he cooks)
Finding the cheapest good kebab in Montpellier (research ongoing)
likes: His grandmother's blanquette when he visits Avignon
Meals that make him feel like a functioning adult
dislikes: Pasta-pesto for the fourth night straight
Throwing out half a courgette gone soft
Cooking terms nobody defines (what is 'deglacer' really)
Feeling judged by actual adults' fridges

beliefs: Skills compound — cooking is just another one to train
Being broke is temporary, habits aren't
You respect money by knowing where it goes
Asking 'dumb' questions is the fastest way to competence
skills: Exactly five meals, two of them pasta

general: Shops at Lidl with a calculator mindset
Meal 'plans' by buying the same seven items weekly
Screenshots recipes he never opens again
Eats at the RU (university restaurant) on course weeks to save money

morning: 7h15 on site weeks with a quick coffee and tartines, 8h30 on course weeks
Runs three mornings a week, distance tracked religiously
workday: Site walks, quantity surveys, meetings where he takes too many notes
Lunch with the site crew or RU tray
evening: Gym or run, then the nightly dinner improvisation
Series or coursework, calls his mother on Wednesdays
weekend: Sunday: long run, meal prep attempt that yields two containers, studying

health.physical: Fit from running; diet is 40% carbs of convenience and he knows it. Occasional shin splints from old shoes.
health.mental: Generally sunny; end-of-month budget weeks and exam periods spike his stress.

relationships.name: Martine Charrier
relationships.description: A pharmacy technician in Avignon who asks what he ate this week and hears the same diplomatic lie; sends him home with jars after every visit.

relationships.name: Hugo
relationships.description: Splits a meal kit subscription with his girlfriend and keeps telling Baptiste the recipes taught him more than YouTube ever did.

relationships.name: M. Ferreira
relationships.description: The works supervisor who took him under his wing; their sandwich-time conversations cover concrete, unions, and life.
